summary: Typed entity-target @ slots and consistent substitution. Search is sound and complete for finite telescope entity projections only; dependent proof fields are retained by the interpretation. Explicit inverse reassociation maps connect the source mini-discourse context to the search telescope. An executable first-candidate resolver has soundness and conditional totality proofs; this choice policy is not attributed to the source.

sources.citation: Bekki & Mineshima (2017), Context-Passing and Underspecification in Dependent Type Semantics, sections 3.4-3.6 pp.28-30, Definition 5; section 4.2.
